description: Adds an elapsed-time counter to the quiz header; the bug increments from the seconds value captured by an effect that runs once, the clean diff uses a functional update with the same empty dependency list.

bug.scenario: After mount the interval callback closes over seconds = 0 from the first render, because the effect runs once with []; every tick calls setSeconds(0 + 1), so the header shows Time: 1s forever.

clean.why_safe: setSeconds((s) => s + 1) reads the current state on every tick, so the effect needs no dependency and the interval set up once counts correctly; it is cleared on unmount.
